title: Week 36: 2nd Master Year 🎓🌧️
content:
Week 36: 2nd Master Year 🎓🌧️

rain

The opening ceremony of my 2nd master year started… in the rain 🌧️😂. Compared to last year, the weather feels way colder 🥶. Most students were standing under the tents, while I decided to stay inside the building, nice and warm ☕🏠. Still don’t know why nobody else joined me — best seat in the house!

pic from second floor

This semester looks pretty chill 😎. The only real challenge is Game AI 🤖🎮, but I already did some prep during the summer, so I feel ready. I also picked up German A1 🇩🇪📖 — hopefully I can speak a little bit by the end of the semester. And of course… it’s internship season 💼. I really need to find one soon 🙏😅.
